WITH RECURSIVE
needed7(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT file,id FROM node WHERE kind IN (197) UNION SELECT p.file,p.id FROM needed7 k CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=k.file AND n.id=k.node CROSS JOIN node p ON p.file=n.file AND p.id=n.parent WHERE p.kind IN (226)),
bounds2(file,node,last) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT k.file,k.node,n."last" FROM r2 k CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=k.file AND n.id=k.node),
regions2(file,node,last) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT b.file,b.node,b.last FROM bounds2 b WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bounds2 outer_region WHERE outer_region.file=b.file AND outer_region.node<b.node AND outer_region.last>=b.node)),
-- clause
r0(file,node) AS (
SELECT file,node FROM r8
),
-- utility[7]
r2(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT a0n0.file,a0n0.id FROM r3 AS seed0 CROSS JOIN node AS a0n0 ON a0n0.file=seed0.file AND a0n0.id=seed0.node WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r6 k WHERE k.file=a0n0.file AND k.node=a0n0.id)
),
-- utility[3]
r3(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT a1n0.file,a1n0.id FROM node AS a1n0 WHERE a1n0.kind IN (137,138,221,222,223,224)
),
-- utility[0]
r4(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a2n0.file,a2n0.id FROM node AS a2n0 WHERE a2n0.kind IN (145)
UNION
SELECT a3n0.file,a3n0.id FROM node AS a3n0 WHERE a3n0.kind IN (197) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r7 k WHERE k.file=a3n0.file AND k.node=a3n0.id))
),
-- inverse descendant closure
r6(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT n.file,n.parent FROM r4 seed CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=seed.file AND n.id=seed.node WHERE n.parent IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT n.file,n.parent FROM r6 w CROSS JOIN node n ON n.file=w.file AND n.id=w.node WHERE n.parent IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r4 s WHERE s.file=w.file AND s.node=w.node)),
-- utility[8] for consumer kinds
r7(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a5n0.file,a5n0.id FROM needed7 AS keys5 CROSS JOIN node AS a5n0 ON a5n0.file=keys5.file AND a5n0.id=keys5.node CROSS JOIN node AS a5n1 ON a5n1.file=a5n0.file AND a5n1.id=a5n0.parent WHERE a5n1.kind IN (125)
UNION
SELECT a6n0.file,a6n0.id FROM needed7 AS keys6 CROSS JOIN node AS a6n0 ON a6n0.file=keys6.file AND a6n0.id=keys6.node CROSS JOIN node AS a6n1 ON a6n1.file=a6n0.file AND a6n1.id=a6n0.parent CROSS JOIN node AS a6n2 ON a6n2.file=a6n0.file AND a6n2.id=a6n0.next WHERE a6n1.kind IN (207) AND a6n2.kind IN (158,224)
UNION
SELECT a7n0.file,a7n0.id FROM needed7 AS keys7 CROSS JOIN node AS a7n0 ON a7n0.file=keys7.file AND a7n0.id=keys7.node CROSS JOIN node AS a7n1 ON a7n1.file=a7n0.file AND a7n1.id=a7n0.parent CROSS JOIN node AS a7n2 ON a7n2.file=a7n1.file AND a7n2.id=a7n1.prev WHERE a7n1.kind IN (158) AND a7n2.kind IN (1) AND node_regex(2,a7n2.file,a7n2.id)
UNION
SELECT a8n0.file,a8n0.id FROM needed7 AS keys8 CROSS JOIN node AS a8n0 ON a8n0.file=keys8.file AND a8n0.id=keys8.node CROSS JOIN node AS a8n1 ON a8n1.file=a8n0.file AND a8n1.id=a8n0.parent CROSS JOIN node AS a8n2 ON a8n2.file=a8n1.file AND a8n2.id=a8n1.prev WHERE a8n1.kind IN (158) AND relation_pattern(3,a8n2.file,a8n2.id) AND a8n2.kind IN (204)
UNION
SELECT a9n0.file,a9n0.id FROM needed7 AS keys9 CROSS JOIN node AS a9n0 ON a9n0.file=keys9.file AND a9n0.id=keys9.node CROSS JOIN node AS a9n1 ON a9n1.file=a9n0.file AND a9n1.id=a9n0.parent CROSS JOIN node AS a9n2 ON a9n2.file=a9n1.file AND a9n2.parent=a9n1.id CROSS JOIN node AS a9n3 ON a9n3.file=a9n2.file AND a9n3.id=a9n2.next CROSS JOIN node AS a9n4 ON a9n4.file=a9n0.file AND a9n4.id=a9n0.prev WHERE a9n1.kind IN (215) AND a9n2.kind IN (1) AND node_regex(4,a9n2.file,a9n2.id) AND node_regex(5,a9n3.file,a9n3.id) AND node_regex(5,a9n4.file,a9n4.id)
UNION
SELECT a10n0.file,a10n0.id FROM r7 AS seed10 CROSS JOIN node AS a10n1 ON a10n1.file=seed10.file AND a10n1.id=seed10.node CROSS JOIN node AS a10n0 ON a10n0.file=a10n1.file AND a10n0.parent=a10n1.id WHERE a10n1.kind IN (226) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM needed7 k WHERE k.file=a10n0.file AND k.node=a10n0.id)
),
-- utility[10] within r2
r8(file,node) AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT a11n0.file,a11n0.id FROM regions2 AS domain11 CROSS JOIN node AS a11n1 ON a11n1.file=domain11.file AND a11n1.id>=domain11.node AND a11n1.id<=domain11.last CROSS JOIN node AS a11n0 ON a11n0.file=a11n1.file AND a11n0.parent=a11n1.id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT 1) AS unit12 CROSS JOIN node AS a12n1 ON a12n1.file=a11n0.file AND a12n1.id=a11n0.prev WHERE node_regex(0,a12n1.file,a12n1.id)) AND a11n1.kind IN (199,200)
UNION
SELECT a13n0.file,a13n0.id FROM regions2 AS domain13 CROSS JOIN node AS a13n1 ON a13n1.file=domain13.file AND a13n1.id>=domain13.node AND a13n1.id<=domain13.last CROSS JOIN node AS a13n0 ON a13n0.file=a13n1.file AND a13n0.parent=a13n1.id CROSS JOIN node AS a13n2 ON a13n2.file=a13n0.file AND a13n2.id=a13n0.prev WHERE a13n1.kind IN (137,228) AND node_regex(1,a13n2.file,a13n2.id)
UNION
SELECT a14n0.file,a14n0.id FROM r8 AS seed14 CROSS JOIN node AS a14n1 ON a14n1.file=seed14.file AND a14n1.id=seed14.node CROSS JOIN node AS a14n0 ON a14n0.file=a14n1.file AND a14n0.parent=a14n1.id WHERE a14n1.kind IN (180,181,184,201,216,218,226)
)
SELECT 0,file,node,json_array() FROM r0 ORDER BY file,node

SELECT a11n0.file,a11n0.id FROM regions2 AS domain11 CROSS JOIN node AS a11n0 ON a11n0.file=domain11.file AND a11n0.id>domain11.node AND a11n0.id<=domain11.last CROSS JOIN node AS a11n1 ON a11n1.file=a11n0.file AND a11n1.id=a11n0.parent WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT 1) AS unit12 CROSS JOIN node AS a12n1 ON a12n1.file=a11n0.file AND a12n1.id=a11n0.prev WHERE node_regex(0,a12n1.file,a12n1.id)) AND a11n1.kind IN (199,200)
UNION
SELECT a13n0.file,a13n0.id FROM regions2 AS domain13 CROSS JOIN node AS a13n0 ON a13n0.file=domain13.file AND a13n0.id>domain13.node AND a13n0.id<=domain13.last CROSS JOIN node AS a13n1 ON a13n1.file=a13n0.file AND a13n1.id=a13n0.parent CROSS JOIN node AS a13n2 ON a13n2.file=a13n0.file AND a13n2.id=a13n0.prev WHERE a13n1.kind IN (137,228) AND node_regex(1,a13n2.file,a13n2.id)
UNION
SELECT a14n0.file,a14n0.id FROM r8 AS seed14 CROSS JOIN node AS a14n1 ON a14n1.file=seed14.file AND a14n1.id=seed14.node CROSS JOIN node AS a14n0 ON a14n0.file=a14n1.file AND a14n0.parent=a14n1.id WHERE a14n1.kind IN (180,181,184,201,216,218,226)
)
